title: Performance Campaign — perf-trial-20260906-0303
summary: Baseline done. Biggest finding: /api/deals takes ~107ms per request because it re-reads ~90 days of price revisions from SQLite and re-runs two analytics passes on EVERY request (homepage uses it). Everything else responds in 1-5ms. Two subagent lanes dispatched: (A) data layer - test suite speed + projection DB size; (B) web interface - compression, caching, frontend payload. Coordinator is fixing the deals hot path.
